title: Velocity ratio expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly expressed as k = sqrt(((1+λ)h)/((1-λ)H)).

title: Force magnitude expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly expressed as F0 = (2mg(1-λ)(H-h))/(h-h0).

title: Impulse magnitude expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be correctly expressed as I = m * sqrt( (2g(1-λ)(H-h)(H^(N+1)-h^(N+1))) / (h(H^N - h^N)) ).

title: Net acceleration analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply Newton's second law to find the net accelerations for descent (a_down = (1-λ)g) and ascent (a_up = (1+λ)g).

title: Energy or kinematics application
description: Important: The solution must correctly use kinematic equations (v^2 = u^2 + 2as) or work-energy principles to relate velocities to heights H and h.

title: Iterative height pattern
description: Important: For part (3), the solution must establish the geometric series for rebound heights after multiple strikes and impacts.

title: Work from variable force
description: Optional: For part (2), the solution may correctly calculate the work done by the triangular force F(y) as (1/2)*F0*(h-h0).

title: Sign error in accelerations
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigning the direction of air resistance, leading to wrong signs in net acceleration expressions (e.g., a_up = (1-λ)g).

title: Velocity ratio misapplication
description: Pitfall: Using the velocity ratio k incorrectly in later parts, such as confusing pre- and post-collision velocities in energy equations.

title: Series summation error
description: Pitfall: Making an error in summing the geometric series for the rebound heights in part (3), leading to an incorrect final expression for I.
